title: Magic mushroom ingredient takes the fight out of aggressive fish
caption:
When biologists exposed combative mangrove rivulus fish to a low dose of psilocybin, high-energy attacks dropped sharply while normal social displays stayed untouched. The finding offers a look into how psychedelics might selectively temper conflict in vertebrate brains without causing total sedation.

Source: Sciencedaily - Magic mushroom ingredient takes the fight out of aggressive fish
